The CDBG (Community Development Block Grant) fund name points to a federal grantor, but the line is left as other/Grants under the 2026-11-12 generic-grant ruling. The same applies to the statement's 'Grant income' 134,239 (receipts[6]), which includes this 107,997.
Under the cost-type rule, this enterprise cost-type line ('Utilities' expense) has the same category as the function 'utilities'. A cost-type name such as Utilities (power, gas, phone) may be meant.
